boundary: Typed pointer reading of ONE focus world as a small directed graph, on one teaching order. The held-back questions are about five course worlds the machine never read (same world sizes and question kinds as training); the development panel is out-of-distribution ten-node parts/reach. The primary label is keyed on the RELATIONAL tier, so gains on the DIRECT_READ kinds alone cannot produce it. No protected final-study, general CAS architecture, or full-machine claim.
